name: Game of Whores
source:
You play for the former manager of a brothel, the goal is to return to the business and at the same time to help one of the 3 main heroines of the game to achieve power and influence.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/manitu]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一家妓院的前经理，目标是重返生意，同时帮助游戏的三位主要女主角之一获得权力和影响力。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/manitu]Patreon[/url]]
